sources: https://murray-countymn.com/county_departments/parks_and_fairgrounds_department/index.php (Murray County Parks: camping fees, seasonal camping, Seven Mile Lake Park amenities), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 14 campsites (one accessible, five seasonal, site 7 the host's) in a row north of the park road, plus a tent area (the map labels it 15 Tent Sites).

sites.source: Murray County Parks page ('14 Campsites (1 Accessible) (5 Seasonal)'; 'Seven Mike Park (Fulda) – 14 sites'; 'Seven Mile Park (Fulda) – 5 seasonal sites') + 2024 campground map (sites 1-14, '7 Host', '15 Tent Sites'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: Murray County Parks page ('14 sites with shower and bathroom facilities'; 'Dump Station'; 'Wireless Internet Available', 'Wireless internet is available for an additional fee') + rules PDF, read 2026-11-11

values.note: Pay on arrival by fee envelope at the drop box, or through the county's online bill pay (not a reservation). Check-out by 4 p.m.

booking.source: Murray County Parks page ('NO RESERVATIONS – camping at Murray County Parks is at a first come first serve basis'; 'Online payment is not considered a reservation') + rules PDF ('a campsite cannot be occupied for longer than 14 consecutive nights unless by permission of the Parks Director'; 'out of their designated sites by 4 p.m. on the date of departure'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: $25 a night; tents $15; WiFi extra. Seasonal sites $1,400 (May 1 - October 1).

fees.source: Murray County Parks page ('Seven Mike Park (Fulda) – 14 sites with shower and bathroom facilities – $25.00 per night'; 'Tenting is available at each of the four parks for $15 per night.'; 'Seven Mile Park (Fulda) – 5 seasonal sites – $1,400.00 per site'), read 2026-11-11

note: Murray County park on the west side of Fulda First Lake, within Fulda. Swimming beach, boat landing, dock, accessible fishing pier, picnic shelters, playground, disc golf and sand volleyball. Campground host on site. --Claude
summary: County parks page, 2024 campground map and park rules read: 14 sites (5 seasonal, site 7 host) not 19, a tent area, $25, first come 14-night limit, showers, dump, WiFi extra. Not waterfront confirmed (sites ~70 m from the lake behind a tree row). Phone added; note cleaned.
flags: SITES count 19 -> 14: the county lists '14 Campsites (1 Accessible) (5 Seasonal)' and the map numbers sites 1-14 (7 = Host); the old note's '14 ... plus 5 long-term seasonal sites' double-counted. 8-9 sites are sold by the night. HOOKUPS: neither the page nor the map says whether sites have electric; left unknown.

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: the nearest pads, sites 1-3 (~43.8606,-95.6007), are ~70 m from Fulda First Lake to the east and south, with a dense tree row and the shoreline tree belt between (Esri imagery; the county map shows the same).
SEASON: the county gives no overnight camping season (seasonal sites run 'May 1 – October 1'); the stored 05-01..09-30 'Approximate' was left as is.
PHONE: none stored -> 507-227-3925 (Murray County Parks Director, named for camping information; also 507-836-1195).
PIN 43.85999,-95.60246 is at the park entrance on S Lafayette Ave, ~135 m SW of the site row (~43.8606,-95.6010); under 250 m, no move proposed.
